nodes.name: Note: WF-08 · Daily health report (08:00 Europe/Berlin)

parameters.content:
## WF-08 · Daily health report (08:00 Europe/Berlin)
One SQL query over the project database (last 24 h): leads (new / repeat / hot / stuck),
orders created, invoices by outcome, review queue size and age, chatbot activity, workflow
errors (top 5), and the result of last night's reconciliation (WF-06).
**Format Health Report** turns it into a traffic light:
🔴 any workflow error or stuck lead · 🟡 review items older than 2 days or > 10 pending · 🟢 otherwise.
Sent every morning via **WF-10**, also on quiet days, so a silent failure is noticed.

parameters.query:
WITH win AS (SELECT now() - interval '24 hours' AS since)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads, win WHERE created_at > since)                                         AS leads_new,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM event_log, win WHERE event_type = 'lead.updated' AND occurred_at > since)    AS leads_repeat,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads, win WHERE scored_at > since AND ai_score >= $1 AND NOT ai_fallback)    AS leads_hot,
  (SELECT round(avg(ai_score)) FROM leads, win WHERE scored_at > since)                              AS leads_avg_score,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads, win WHERE scored_at > since AND ai_fallback)                          AS leads_fallback,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads WHERE status = 'received' AND created_at < now() - interval '30 minutes') AS leads_stuck,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM event_log, win WHERE event_type = 'order.created' AND occurred_at > since)   AS orders_created,
  (SELECT coalesce(sum((data->>'amount_total')::numeric), 0) FROM event_log, win
     WHERE event_type = 'order.created' AND occurred_at > since)                                     AS orders_value,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_object_agg(status, n), '{}'::json) FROM
     (SELECT status, count(*) n FROM documents, win WHERE updated_at > since GROUP BY status) d)     AS documents,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM review_queue WHERE status = 'pending')                                        AS review_pending,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_object_agg(item_type, n), '{}'::json) FROM
     (SELECT item_type, count(*) n FROM review_queue WHERE status = 'pending' GROUP BY item_type) r) AS review_by_type,
  (SELECT extract(day FROM now() - min(created_at))::int FROM review_queue WHERE status = 'pending') AS review_oldest_days,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM event_log, win WHERE event_type = 'chat.escalated' AND occurred_at > since)  AS chat_escalations,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM event_log, win WHERE event_type LIKE 'chat.order_lookup%' AND occurred_at > since) AS chat_lookups,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM workflow_errors, win WHERE occurred_at > since)                              AS errors_24h,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(e), '[]'::json) FROM
     (SELECT workflow_name, node_name, count(*) n, max(error_message) example
      FROM workflow_errors, win WHERE occurred_at > since
      GROUP BY workflow_name, node_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5) e)                                  AS top_errors,
  (SELECT message || ' (' || to_char(occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM. HH24:MI') || ')'
     FROM event_log WHERE event_type = 'reconciliation.completed' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1)          AS last_reconciliation;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ 'WF-08 Daily Health Report', 'report.health_sent', null, null, $('Format Health Report').first().json.subject, JSON.stringify({ status: $('Format Health Report').first().json.status }), $execution.id ] }}
